text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: This... "cake". Western confection though it be, gleams fair as a jeweled casket. So many kinds, so many choices... it truly baffles the mind on where one's eyes are to set. Yet if one is wandering back and forth together with their beloved, such troubles are a joy in themselves... is it not so, my dear?
text_block_list.orig_text:
『けぇき』なる洋菓子、
宝石箱の如く煌びやかで
見目麗しく。
様々に品々し、
且つ数多あり、
目移りする事甚だし。
されど
情人と右往左往するならば、
煩悶も又
愉快也……
のう、
お前さま？

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: Korokoro... "Shortcake is the standard for birthdays", so the shopkeeper assured us. A whole cake may be quite large... but for youthful stomachs, I believe it should pose no trouble at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロコロ……
然り、
然り。
「しょおとけぇきは
誕生日の定番」、
なる手代殿の薦め在らば。
『ほぉる』丸ごとは大なれど、
若人の胃腸なれば
事無しと思い侍り。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: Just so... all that befell this time was like a dream within a dream, truly strange beyond words. All the more reason I wish to savor this "birthday" of the mortal world. For in my former life, such days were ever treated with stiff, exalted reverence, like treasures of gold and jade.
text_block_list.orig_text:
然様──
此度の仕儀、
夢に在りて夢を見るが如き、
真奇怪千万な有様。
為ればこそ、
現世の『ばぁすでぇ』を楽しみたく候。
娑婆に於いては、
金枝玉葉の如く
崇め奉られるが
常でありんした故。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: Why, to receive congratulations from you, Lord Knight -- there is no joy that could surpass it. Of the countless years I have lived, this day stands out as one truly most blessed. My gratitude to you knows no bounds.
text_block_list.orig_text:
況や、
騎士殿より寿ぎを頂けるとあらば、
是に勝る慶びは無く──
幾星霜を重ねし中でも、
此度はいと抜き出でて
目出度き日に候。
騎士殿には
感謝してもしきれませぬ也。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: My, my... as ever, you do know how to charm a lady, dear Lord Knight. As New Year's Eve grows late, the chill deepens all the more... Come, let us take each other's hands and hasten home together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんともはや──
相も変わらず、
騎士殿はお上手でありんすな。
大晦も更けるとなれば
寒さもひとしお、
手と手を重ね、
疾く帰路へ就くといたしんしょう。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: Hmm... you would place as many candles upon it as the years I have lived? To turn something this lovely into a pincushion of flames would be most inelegant indeed. A modest number shall suffice, I think. And once they are lit, then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
フム……
この『けぇき』に、
わっちの年の数と
同じだけの蠟燭を？
斯様に美しき見た目、
針山と処するは
風雅に反する所業。
程々で宜しきかと思い侍り。
はて扨、
火をつけた後は──……

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh. The feelings that well up now... words cannot hope to capture them. No... this is what you modern folk call "emo", is it not♪...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……フフ。
思ひ染むこと、
得も云はず──
否、
是ぞ
『えもい』
でありんすな……♪

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: My... it is I who owe you deepest thanks. Blowing out the candles like this... it makes my heart dance, and yet it finds me shy and flustered too. Truly, it is no wonder children look forward to it so dearly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっちの方こそ、
深甚の感謝を申し上げまする。
蝋燭を吹き消すときの……
胸躍る、
なんとも面映ゆい心地。
幼子らが心待ちにするのも、
むべなるかな。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: And moreover... your smile, softly lit by the candlelight... how lovely it is. It makes me feel as though I have received the greatest reward of all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かてて加えて、
仄明かりに照らさるる
お前さまの笑顔──
その愛らしき事。
何よりの褒美を頂戴した心持に成り申して候。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: Well then, Lord Knight. Let us partake of this "cake" and our New Year soba... and afterward, hand in hand once more, let us go together to the shrine for the traditional midnight visit. There, I shall pray that in the coming year as well... I may spend such days by your side again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
では、
騎士殿や。
此方の『けぇき』と
蕎麦を頂き──
その後に。
又もやわっちと手と手を重ね、
二年参りに向かいましょうぞ。
明年も、
斯くの如き日を、
お前さまと共に過ごせん事を
願掛けに──
